Who we are
EasySend was founded to transform the way paper-based industries work. We’re a growing team. Together, we’re leading the no-code digital revolution for the largest insurance, banking, and financial institutions in America and Europe.

Join our mission

Our product
We’re building a revolutionary no-code platform that allows developers to transform any manual process into a custom digital journey in days.
Remote and hybrid
Whether you prefer working remotely or in the office, we have a space that fits your most effective work mode.

The people who make us

Our team loves to work with purpose, take ownership, and make an impact. Our offices are located across the world: the United States, Germany, and Israel, and we’re looking to grow. We’ll consider applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, or disability status.

Our values

EasySend is an equal-opportunity employer where we celebrate diversity.

Our company culture is the backbone of our success and we’re committed to fostering an environment based on the values of ownership, teamwork, professionalism and a hunger for success.
Ownership
We empower our team members to take responsibility for their work, encouraging initiative and accountability in all aspects of our product development process.
Teamwork
Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. We value diverse perspectives and believe that great products are built through collective effort and open communication.
Professionalism
We uphold high standards in our work and interactions, striving for excellence while treating each other and our clients with respect and integrity.
Hunger for  success
We are driven by our ambition to innovate and excel. Our team is motivated by challenges, always seeking to learn and grow in pursuit of our goals.

The benefits of
working at EasySend

We’ve got you covered
Our benefits package covers health insurance, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability. You’ll have a development budget and Advanced Study Fund to keep learning outside of the office. Once you start, we’ll send you all the equipment you need to work remotely and in the office.

We have a 401(k) Plan for employees in the US and a company pension in Israel.
Work-life balance
Enjoy flexible hours, so you can work when you’re most productive and still make time for your friends, family, and hobbies. We believe that living a balanced life makes people happy and healthy—and we’ll help you achieve that goal.
Open communication
Everyone’s voice matters. At EasySend, you’ll have an equal opportunity to bring your ideas, voice, thoughts, and creativity to the table. We also believe that different lifestyles, experiences, and perspectives create richer, more holistic outcomes.
Fun company culture
Having a great company culture means getting to spend time together outside of office hours. We love to host weekly happy hours, cater brunch every Monday, plan offline and online workshops company-wide and we even go on a company retreat once a year.
